findings.title: Treat stream exhaustion before the dispatch result as an error
findings.description: When `receive_response()` ends without a result and no background task is active, this method returns the collected text even if the dispatch’s own result was never seen. A truncated stream can therefore be reported as a successful, possibly partial response. Raise `ProviderError` whenever the own result is missing; only return collected text after the dispatch result has arrived.

findings.title: Check session usability before changing the model
findings.description: After a reconnect fails, `set_model()` still calls the replacement client without checking `unusable_reason`. The dispatch action calls `set_model()` before `dispatch()`, so a later step touches the failed client before reaching `dispatch()`’s usability guard. Guard this operation too, so subsequent uses fail immediately with the recorded reconnect reason.

findings.title: Add a load test for the background-wait path
findings.description: The new async stream-wait and timeout behavior is covered with scripted client tests, but the project rules require a load test for network/concurrency paths that asserts a resource or latency bound. Add a realistic load test for background-agent waiting and its timeout behavior; the current `tests/load/` coverage does not exercise this path.
